line: Catch niggas right where they momma residin’, uh
vault_lines: Catch niggas right where they momma residin', uh
meaning: One thing that is important to remember is that a lot of street beefs start while people are in high school or in their early 20’s, meaning a lot of gang members still live with their parents. Even though other people live there, the opps don’t care and will often handle the situation right there. Ironically, Foolio’s mom caught a stray bullet after he dropped his address on a song.

line: Hoes droppin’ lo’s, we know where they hidin’
vault_lines: Hoes droppin' lo's, we know where they hidin'
meaning: Often times women are used in gang wars to lure in men from opposing sides so they can be caught lacking by their opps.

line: All through the ’Raq, know I do my thing
vault_lines: All through the 'Raq, know I do my thing
meaning: “The Raq” is another name for the city of Chicago and it got this name around 2011 where more Americans were dying in Chicago than Iraq. At the time Operation Iraqi Freedom was in full effect.

vault_lines: Jump-Out Gang, Blitz Gang, Drench Gang, No Limit Gang, Pistol Gang
meaning: These are both names for the gang headquartered at 79th and Essex ST in the Eastside of Chicago. G Herbo’s username on Instagram is NoLimitHerbo

line: Hit a boss in a Hellcat, I damn near wrecked the SRT
vault_lines: Hit a boss in a Hellcat, I damn near wrecked the SRT
meaning:
SRT stands for Street and Racing Technology, but it is a premium version of the Dodge challenger, similar to how Chevy has Z71 trucks.


Also, hellcat is the type of engine it has which enables extremely fast speeds.

line: I ain’t checkin’ in no city, why you think we buyin’ guns?
vault_lines: I ain't checkin' in no city, why you think we buyin' guns?
meaning: “Checking in” is the practice of rappers letting local gang members know before they travel to a city. However, Foolio claims he doesn’t do that and uses guns to fight if he has to.

line: Every Glock come with a switch, you know I like my bitches foreign
vault_lines: Every Glock come with a switch, you know I like my bitches foreign
meaning: A switch is a device that enables a semi-automatic pistol fire in full auto, often times they come from other countries.

line: Like Tupac, I got the juice
vault_lines: Bitch, I'm runnin' to that loot, like Tupac, I got the juice
meaning: Tupac Shakur was an amazing rapper, actor, and public figure in the 1990’s, but was unfortunately killed in 1996. In 1992, Juice came out which starred 2pac and it became a classic.

line: You can duck from everything, but you can’t duck this ARP
vault_lines: You can duck from everything, but you can't duck this ARP
meaning: An ARP is an acronym which means assault rifle pistol. They shooting rifle rounds(223, 556, and 7.62) but they do not come with a stock which separates them from regular ARs.

line: Glock 23 in arm reach, got 23's on my feet
vault_lines: Glock 23 in arm reach, got 23's on my feet
meaning: Glock 23 is a subcompact semi-automatic pistol that shoots a .40 caliber round.

vault_lines: Point a finger and they drop 'em, I'm original Don Dada
meaning: Don Dada is a word to talk about someone who is greatly respected in an area; or a leader of many people.

line: I got Bibby on my mind,
vault_lines: I got Bibby on my mind, steppin' for that boy Osama
meaning: Bibby was Foolio’s younger brother who was shot and killed, allegedly by ATK and NHG member, Ksoo. Apparently Ksoo caught him walking to the Hilltop Apartments and shot him.
